backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing media uploads, live sessions, and user profiles with access control and blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file for reference.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment config for II settings, canister IDs, network mode, and admin token usage.
frontend/docs/ic-mainnet-deployment.md: Guide outlining steps and prerequisites for deploying OmniStream to the IC mainnet.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining global theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring hash-based routing, splash screen, theme provider, and route tree.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper with navbar, footer, FAB, and backend-unavailable banner based on actor/query state.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Provides sign-in/sign-out button logic using Internet Identity and clears cached data on logout or auth errors.
frontend/src/components/BackendUnavailab: Displays an alert when the backend is unreachable and offers a reload option and correct URL hint.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Shows a simple centered empty-state layout with an icon, title, and description.
frontend/src/components/FloatingActionBu: Authenticated users get a floating button that expands to quick actions for uploading media or starting a live stream.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, navigation links, community info, and a dynamic year.
frontend/src/components/NavBar.tsx: Top navigation bar with links, user info, and authentication controls, adapting to login state.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting new users to enter and save a display name before proceeding.
frontend/src/components/ShortCard.tsx: Card component displaying a vertical short video preview with title and duration.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Shows a full‑screen splash image during initial loading.
frontend/src/components/UploadForm.tsx: Handles video/short uploads with metadata, duration extraction, validation, progress, and submission.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Card showing a video thumbnail, duration, and creation date, linking to the watch page.
frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx: A React video player component with play, pause, seek, volume, mute, and fullscreen controls exposing a pause method via ref.
frontend/src/components/ViewerTimer.tsx: A timer component that counts down between user-defined times and triggers a callback when finished.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, logout, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating media, user profiles, and combined feed data through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining color variables, dark mode styles, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point mounting React with InternetIdentityProvider and React Query setup.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home feed page showing combined videos and shorts, handling loading, profile setup, and rendering media cards.
frontend/src/pages/LiveDetailsPage.tsx: Displays details for a specific live session, handles loading/error states, and allows the session owner to end the stream.
frontend/src/pages/LivePage.tsx: Lists active live sessions and provides a form for authenticated users to start new live sessions.
frontend/src/pages/ShortsPage.tsx: Fetches and displays a grid of short-form videos with a loading state and fallback empty state.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: Manages media upload flow, requiring authentication and profile setup before showing the upload form.
frontend/src/pages/WatchPage.tsx: Loads and plays a video or short by title, showing metadata and handling backend or not-found errors.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, feature list, issues, and requirements for building and deploying the OmniStream video-sharing site. Captures current problems with uploads, deployment resolution, and missing viewer timer UI.
